options.name: debug
options.description: Debug diagnose privilege. Required when I(state=present). Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: general
options.description: General configuration privilege. Required when I(state=present). Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: kvm
options.description: Remote KVM configuration privilege. Required when I(state=present). Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: media
options.description: Remote media configuration privilege. Required when I(state=present). Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: name
options.description: Group name. The range of group name  for M6 model is OEM1,OEM2,OEM3,OEM4.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: power
options.description: Power control privilege. Required when I(state=present). Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: pri
options.description: Group privilege. Required when I(state=present). Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: security
options.description: Security configuration privilege. Required when I(state=present). Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: self
options.description: Itself configuration privilege. Required when I(state=present). Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the user group should exist or not, taking action if the state is different from what is stated.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.
